I would like to write all the names but I rather what you to see it for yourself. Consistency is tacky for me and dries slow unless you will apply it in front of the fan. It does look like it is glowy in your skin because of the formulas mixed in this. avis.titre: PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Glow Pad— MUST TRY!

avis.titre: ANUA Rice 70 Intensive Moisturizing Milk - New Holy Grail
avis.texte: As someone with combination skin that's both oily in the T-zone but also has random very dry areas, finding the right moisturizer has always been a challenging balance. avis.titre: A new staple in my skincare routine!

Once it's dry, I remove the pad and an excess that is left on my face I press it into my skin using my fingers. These pads are a dual sided effect! One side is hydrate and soothe, the other is smoothing! The glow these pads give your skin, is simply unmatched. They are infused with PDRN, Hyaluronic Acid and even Collagen! As someone in my 30's, my skin craves collagen, so this is definitely a must-have for me and my skincare needs! I apply the gel-textured side to my cheeks like a mini mask while I brush my teeth or dry my hair. Then I flip to the smooth side to swipe over the rest of my face and neck. It's like the serum in pad form, but with a little self-care moment built in. These work beautifully on their own or as a prep step under the matching serum. If you love convenience or need a quick glow-up, these are worth keeping in the fridge for an extra-refreshing treat. Note: Product was received as part of an educational promotion.

You need it upright at all times, and if you hold it at an angle for even a second, serum will leak out of the box. I wasn't a fan of this because as I was trying to move it around, liquid was slightly spilling out of the lid. 🫐 Formula wise, while it does take a bit to absorb, it does give a long lasting moisture that lasts for at least a day. I liked how glowy my skin looked and how easy it was to apply makeup the following day. It contains sodium based PDRN, which is great for all skin types, including sensitive ones.
